slots.name: CDU vote change
slots.sentence: In Saxony-Anhalt and the city-state of Berlin, where it had been in government, the CDU dropped by 10% compared to the previous election and lost its hold on power.

slots.name: election date
slots.sentence: The country's leading Christian Democrats suffered severe losses in two German states in September, heaping pressure on Chancellor Friedrich Merz to keep the far-right AfD at bay.

slots.name: euro value status
slots.sentence: The uncertainty, alongside renewed political tension in France, is a headwind for the euro , which has hit its lowest levels in over a year.

slots.name: parliamentary threshold
slots.sentence: In Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, the party even failed to cross the 5% threshold for representation in parliament.

slots.name: number of elections
slots.sentence: Germany held three state elections in September, two of them in eastern states.
